# Delete Search Round Trip — delete → search confirms removal

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write delete-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/delete-note.md'

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write keep-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/keep-note.md'

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write delete-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/delete-decision.md'

# --- Search finds all pages before delete ---

exec akb search 'distributed databases'
stdout 'notes/delete-note.md'
stdout 'notes/keep-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/delete-decision.md'

# --- Delete a page ---

exec akb delete notes/delete-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/delete-note.md'

# --- Search no longer finds deleted page ---

exec akb search 'distributed databases'
! stdout 'notes/delete-note.md'
stdout 'notes/keep-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/delete-decision.md'

# --- Search for unique content of deleted page returns nothing ---

exec akb search 'replication'
! stdout 'notes/delete-note.md'

# --- Delete another page ---

exec akb delete decisions/delete-decision.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/decisions/delete-decision.md'

# --- Search no longer finds second deleted page ---

exec akb search 'distributed databases'
! stdout 'decisions/delete-decision.md'
stdout 'notes/keep-note.md'

# --- Remaining page still searchable ---

exec akb search 'caching'
stdout 'notes/keep-note.md'

# --- Delete last page ---

exec akb delete notes/keep-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/keep-note.md'

# --- Search returns no results ---

exec akb search 'distributed databases'
! stdout .

# --- Links also confirm removal ---

exec akb orphans
! stdout .

# --- Core I/O still works after all deletes ---

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 0'

exec akb list
! stdout .

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Delete Search Note
summary: Note for delete-search round trip
tags: deletesearch
---
This note is about distributed databases and replication.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Keep This Note
summary: Note that stays after delete
tags: deletesearch
---
Content about distributed databases and caching.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Delete Search Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for delete-search round trip
tags: deletesearch
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

We chose distributed databases for our data layer.

## Decision

Decided.

## Consequences

Recorded.
